steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Talulah.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...Hm? You rarely make that face, friend. What's wrong?

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: We've decided.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: We're going to stay here.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Ah, uh... putting it another way, there are some of us willing to stay here. And some are thinking about getting out of Ursus territory.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: But either way, none of us'll be carrying on heading south with you. We're sorry.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Alright. I see.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: You're not even going to ask for a reason?

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: You're the one who taught us, took us all this way up 'til today—

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: And does that mean you have to obey me, keep your life tied to your blade, fight Ursus to your last breath?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Because it's never been like that. Never been, friend. You've got the cart and the beast mixed up.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Ha ha... I guess. That's like you, Talulah, it really is.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'm not your ruler. And you deserve to have this land, in the first place. Even if filled with corpses, turbulent with bad memories, the tundra is, as it was, your homeland.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You're all strong. I'm sure you'll find a way to prevail through it all.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: If you want, I can send you off.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: No, no, don't, really. You should know it wasn't exactly the firmest thing, making this decision, anyhow...

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Ha, thinking about it, I used to be one of your people. I'll be telling my future companions plenty of stories about you.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Here's begging for your mercy, then.

steps.name: Distant Shout
steps.text: Talulah, the campfire's up!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Alright, I'll be there in a moment!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Friend, will tonight be our last meal together?

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Just wait a bit longer... some others'll want to talk with you too, probably. All of them would.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: ...Talulah.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: How do you guarantee that everyone who stands by your side works with you as one? How do you know betrayal or some other crap isn't headed your way?

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Uh... no, I guess you obviously have your ways. You're so smart, so strong to boot, and you know so much. A wound here or some bleeding there wouldn't slow your pace down, would it?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...The praise is one thing, but could you not make me out to be so terrifying?

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Ha ha, don't get us wrong, one or two frustrations wouldn't make us lose our gall. We're no cowards...

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: I just suddenly realized. Actually, maybe not everyone thinks... thinks the same as you, anyway. Yeah.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: I mean, take me. I was gonna die anyway. I just chose to tag along with you all so I'd be able to eat something, live a few more days of my life.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Moment I ate my own fill, I realized there were actually plenty like me. And I figured it'd be nice if they could eat their fill too...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Strength, particularly in goodwill. They're qualities hard to come by.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Yep. Hard, for sure. So it's definitely not everyone who thinks that way.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Who can guarantee we'll keep moving on, that we won't meet a crueler end? The old noblemen eliminating us all, implicating the innocent poor and all their children along the way?

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: I... it doesn't really matter to me, but when I realize all the other ways it could go, it stresses me out.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: And not to mention that to some people, nothing else matters except their own fill... if the question is just feeding yourself, even I could come up with plenty of ideas, like... ngh.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Like selling out.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Selling out what matters to us. Plenty of people are itching to destroy us, and they'd happily let some nobody Infected off to dispatch the remaining rebels. Couldn't be more cost-effective if you tried.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: So I think... seeing that's how things are, we can't leave here now more than ever.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Talulah, we can't take every single person with us, can we?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I have to... concede that.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: That being the case, before we head all the way south and win all that goodness you talked about... uh, what about the tundra? What about the Infected left behind on it?

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Not just the tundra, really... the world's so vast, and to say it straight, some people are just thinking of taking the chance to leave this place.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Finding like-minded folk elsewhere in hardship and distress, seeing if other places... might have a niche in them for the Infected.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Some people might look at it that way.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Your seeing things this way honestly makes me really... happy.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Uh... feels like the why would fly over my head, so I'm just gonna not ask...

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: C—circling back, uh... does the fact we're leaving at such a critical point mean we'll be considered deserters? I don't really get all that too well, which is why I came to talk to you.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: *chuckle* Well, of course not.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Be it Talulah, the Guerrillas, so on, they're all 'names' and nothing more.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You carry what lies beneath your names... your mindsets, spirits. You carry that sublime fire of resistance, scattering it across this world's every part. For all this, where's the need to fault yourself?

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Alright!

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Frankly, I only sort of get it still, but with those words coming from you, Talulah, that puts me at ease.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Be at ease, really.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Alright... I can't let the hunters' efforts go to waste. The knack you all have for laying out traps really opens my eyes.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: I'll miss the days I was able to eat like this. Talulah, we'll travel to every corner of this land.

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Hey, everyone over here! Food's ready!
